questions.question: The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 15. If the digits are reversed, the number is decreased by 27. Find the number.
If the number 481*673 is divisible by 9, what is the digit *?
Find the greatest number which divides 1657 and 2037 leaving remainder 6 in each case.
A shopkeeper marks his goods 20% above cost price and gives a discount of 10%. Find his profit percentage.
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100. MP = 120. SP after 10% discount = 120 × 0.9 = 108. Profit = 8%.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, one got 55% of total votes and won by 300 votes. Find total votes.
questions.explanation: Winning candidate got 55%, loser got 45%. Difference = 10% = 300 votes. Total votes = 300/0.10 = 3000.

questions.question: The price of sugar increases by 25%. By what percent must a householder reduce consumption so that expenditure on sugar remains unchanged?
A trader sold an article at a loss of 5%. If the selling price had been increased by Rs. 100, there would have been a gain of 10%. What was the cost price?
By selling 33 items, a person gains the cost price of 11 items. Find the gain percent.
questions.explanation: Gain = CP of 11 items. SP of 33 = CP of 33 + CP of 11 = CP of 44. Gain% = (11/33) × 100 = 33.33%.

questions.question: A sum of money amounts to Rs. 9800 after 5 years and Rs. 12005 after 8 years at the same rate of simple interest. Find the rate of interest per annum.
What is the compound interest on Rs. 4000 for 3 years at 10% per annum?
The difference between CI and SI on a sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is Rs. 40. Find the principal.
A can do a piece of work in 30 days and B can do the same work in 20 days. They work together for 10 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A alone complete the remaining work?
questions.explanation: Together in 10 days: 10×(1/30+1/20) = 10×(5/60) = 10/12 = 5/6 work done. Remaining = 1/6. A does 1/6 work in 30/6 = 5 days.

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. B and C together in 15 days. A and C together in 20 days. In how many days will all three complete the work together?
A train 240 m long passes a pole in 24 seconds. How long will it take to pass a platform 180 m long?
questions.explanation: Speed = 240/24 = 10 m/s. Distance to cover = 240+180 = 420 m. Time = 420/10 = 42 seconds.

questions.question: Two trains start simultaneously from stations A and B, 300 km apart, towards each other. Their speeds are 60 km/h and 40 km/h. At what distance from A will they meet?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 100 km/h. Time to meet = 300/100 = 3 hours. Distance from A = 60×3 = 180 km.

questions.question: A table shows bank deposits (in crores): 2019: 450, 2020: 540, 2021: 630, 2022: 720, 2023: 810. What is the percentage increase in deposits from 2020 to 2023?
The bar chart shows sales (units): Q1=200, Q2=250, Q3=300, Q4=350. What is the average quarterly sales?
The ratio of milk to water in a mixture is 4:1. If 10 litres of water is added, the new ratio becomes 2:1. Find the initial quantity of milk.
questions.explanation: Let milk = 4x, water = x. New water = x+10. 4x/(x+10) = 2/1 → 4x = 2x+20 → 2x=20 → x=10. Milk = 40 litres.

questions.question: The radius of a circle is increased by 50%. Find the percentage increase in its area.
questions.explanation: New radius = 1.5r. New area = π(1.5r)² = 2.25πr². Increase = 1.25πr². Percentage = 125%.

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are in ratio 3:2:1. If the total surface area is 88 sq.m, find the length.
questions.explanation: Let l=3k, b=2k, h=k. TSA = 2(lb+bh+lh) = 2(6k²+2k²+3k²) = 22k² = 88 → k²=4 → k=2. Length = 6 m.

questions.question: The average age of 40 students is 14.95 years. If 5 students join whose average age is 13 years, find the new average.
questions.explanation: Total age = 40×14.95 = 598. New total = 598 + 5×13 = 598+65 = 663. New average = 663/45 = 14.73 ≈ 14.73. Closest: 14.68 based on actual calculation 663/45 = 14.733.
